document.summary: NAD-dependent dehydrogenases with the 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase N-terminal NAD-binding (3HCDH_N) and C-terminal (3HCDH) domains. The reviewed members fall into three functional groups. SF9 holds mycobacterial FadB2. SF1 holds the animal lambda-crystallins (L-gulonate 3-dehydrogenase), and SF7 includes the Bacillus FadN hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase with an additional hydratase-like domain; other members require separate substrate and architecture assessment.

SF5 itself contains both 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenases and L-carnitine dehydrogenases, so neither the carnitine nor the acyl-CoA substrate transfers from the subfamily label.
